freeze.effective_condition: this exact manifest and referenced bytes are merged into main before any candidate economic result is read
freeze.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(',', ':'); allow_nan=false
freeze.identity_change_policy: any feature, direction, window, horizon, threshold, universe, cost, gate, or sample change requires a new candidate_id and entirely new future evidence

universe_freeze.selection_inputs: point-in-time liquidity, LTD, and contract rules observed before candidate calibration

raw_observation_contract.journal_shape: one run-global callback-order journal before any per-symbol view
raw_observation_contract.control_scope_policy: COLLECTOR_START, DISCONNECT, RECONNECT, CLOCK_EPOCH_CHANGE, BACKPRESSURE_ABORT, SINK_FAILURE_ABORT, and COLLECTOR_STOP are GENERATION_GLOBAL; SESSION_SEGMENT_START and SESSION_SEGMENT_END are EXACT_CONTRACT_SEGMENT and bind exact_contract + session_family + segment_id + official_trading_day + collector_generation + clock_epoch
raw_observation_contract.canonical_raw_policy: all CONTROL identity/reason/scope text is nonempty canonical text, official_trading_day is canonical ISO date text, callback_entry_receive_monotonic_ns is positive, and all eight retained provider numeric fields are string, integer, or null but never bool/float
raw_observation_contract.complete_stream_preflight: before economic state, scan every row including any future STOP suffix; reject a row after COLLECTOR_STOP/BACKPRESSURE_ABORT/SINK_FAILURE_ABORT in that generation and validate every run-wide PROVEN_UNIQUE provider-id duplicate/conflict/explicit-marker relation
raw_observation_contract.provider_update_id_policy: nullable and never synthesized; its uniqueness semantics must be proven in P1.5 before it can classify a duplicate
raw_observation_contract.mutable_provider_object_policy: copy the provider state at callback or poll-cycle entry after paired UTC/monotonic capture and sequence allocation, before any queue or downstream work
raw_observation_contract.poll_cycle_policy: if the provider exposes a mutable poll-cycle snapshot rather than events, retain provider_batch_id and within_batch_rank and limit claims to collector-enumerated per-contract state changes
raw_observation_contract.raw_invalid_policy: missing, non-finite, zero, locked, crossed, or otherwise invalid raw values remain in the journal and quality denominator

partition_custody.trust_boundary: integrity is asserted only relative to externally saved custody-root pins plus an externally supplied terminal head hash and seal; custody does not create an independent trust anchor
partition_custody.root_policy: absolute normalized owner-only directory; an existing root requires externally retained path, directory-identity, and parent-identity pins plus explicit terminal or genesis anchors
partition_custody.run_generation_policy: one custody root is fixed to one run_id and may contain successive collector generations; a terminated collector_generation identifier cannot reappear
partition_custody.append_time_policy: after full chain verification, pin and check every sealed manifest/data identity plus the current append descriptor, lock identity, root version, and trusted terminal metadata around writes; verify exact byte growth and appended bytes after writes; any mismatch poisons and quarantines the generation
partition_custody.orphan_recovery_policy: every JSONL in the custody root must be covered by a verified closed manifest or be the requested current partition; an unsealed crash tail must be explicitly resumed and cannot be skipped by creating a later partition
partition_custody.partial_tail_policy: fail closed and quarantine the generation; never truncate and continue silently
partition_custody.code_sha_policy: required lowercase 40- or 64-character hexadecimal revision identity
partition_custody.read_only_replay_policy: reader takes external root pins plus terminal partition hash/seal, performs no explicit write, lock, quarantine, repair, content, or namespace mutation, requires exact 0600 owner-only regular files and, if a writer lock exists, requires it to be empty, rejects orphan/unsealed files, and recursively re-verifies all raw and manifest bytes before replay
partition_custody.recursive_terminal_seal_policy: each manifest seal binds previous_partition_hash and previous_partition_seal_id so the terminal seal recursively commits all prior manifest metadata
partition_custody.manifest_input_policy: manifest JSON is canonical UTF-8 object-plus-newline no larger than 1048576 bytes; closed_at_utc and code_sha are canonical text and the latter is an exact lowercase 40/64 hex identity

ordering_and_reset.collector_sequence_scope: run-global callback order inside one collector_generation; one run may contain multiple generations
ordering_and_reset.collector_sequence_rule: strictly gapless +1; gap, rollback, or reuse aborts the entire generation
ordering_and_reset.same_source_timestamp_policy: retain and process each callback in collector_seq order
ordering_and_reset.proven_unique_id_same_payload_policy: retain every raw row; after P1.5 proves global uniqueness, compare the full provider payload against a run-wide provider-id map across all collector generations and exclude an exact repeated payload from feature/replay even when nonadjacent
ordering_and_reset.monotonic_comparability: only inside one collector_generation and clock_epoch
ordering_and_reset.process_restart_policy: new collector_generation and clock_epoch; collector_seq restarts at one; all feature state resets; a terminated collector_generation identifier is never reusable
ordering_and_reset.clock_step_policy: new clock_epoch and full feature reset
ordering_and_reset.active_clock: monotonic elapsed time inside one eligible continuous segment; normal quote silence advances time, while a scheduled break or excluded interval starts a new segment
ordering_and_reset.active_monotonic_delta_rule: inside one segment, active_time delta must equal receive_monotonic delta
ordering_and_reset.long_gap_boundary: delta >= long_gap_ns resets; delta < long_gap_ns remains eligible
reset_events: invalid, locked, crossed, or missing BBO
ordering_and_reset.post_reset_first_valid_state: baseline only; no contribution and no signal

clock_quality_gate.row_level_replay_precondition: before creating economic state, reject any raw quote that is not SYNCED, exceeds offset/uncertainty/precision limits, or has negative corrected lag
clock_quality_gate.aggregate_fixture_policy: at 1000 or more replay quotes enforce p99 <= 250ms before economic state; a smaller synthetic mechanism fixture may be recalculated but remains holdout BLOCKED for insufficient clock evidence
clock_quality_gate.failure_effect: descriptive feature evidence only; price-taker markout, PnL, and economic claims forbidden

feature_contract.previous_state_scope: same exact_contract, session_family, segment_id, collector_generation, and clock_epoch
feature_contract.window_interval: (t-10s,t] on receive active time, including the triggering update
feature_contract.depth_scale: arithmetic mean of current-state transition_depth for transitions retained in the window; the outside baseline is excluded
feature_contract.decimal_rule: base-10 Decimal with a local precision of 50 and ROUND_HALF_EVEN
feature_contract.primary_direction: continuation only: positive score long, negative score short
feature_contract.evaluation_frequency: level trigger evaluated after every qualified non-duplicate update

markout_and_execution.signal_reference_mid: mid of the qualified triggering BBO received at signal time
markout_and_execution.markout_reference: mid of the first fresh qualified BBO received at or after 30 active seconds in the same segment
markout_and_execution.entry: first qualified same-lane BBO after latency; long buys ask and short sells bid
markout_and_execution.exit: after entry plus 30 active seconds, recognize the horizon on the first same-lane observation, wait 500ms, then use the first qualified BBO whose source_event_utc_ns is at least the per-attempt accepted-source high-water; a source-time regression is retained but skipped and cannot begin or satisfy exit; long sells bid and short buys ask
markout_and_execution.new_entry_remaining_boundary: a signal quote is PIT-eligible only when frozen segment_end_utc_ns - callback_entry_receive_utc_ns >= new_entry_min_remaining_segment_ns
markout_and_execution.overlapping_level_signals: suppress while a position is open and report every suppression
markout_and_execution.primary_cost: observed bid/ask plus point-in-time exchange fee, close-today treatment, and frozen broker markup
markout_and_execution.stress: one second latency per decision plus one extra tick per leg
markout_and_execution.terminal_exit_timeout: if no qualified exit within five seconds after the horizon, take the next qualified same-segment side BBO, retain the trade, and fail that contract-day data gate
markout_and_execution.terminal_unpriced: if no later execution-usable same-segment quote exists, retain an UNPRICED_TERMINAL exposure with signed terminal_position_lots, STOP replay globally, mark later coverage incomplete, and never drop or invent a fill
markout_and_execution.accounting_failure_after_exit: if an execution-usable exit quote exists but trusted PIT accounting fails, retain the exit raw hash, record an ACCOUNTING-prefixed terminal reason, preserve signed terminal_position_lots, emit no CLOSED trade, and STOP replay globally
markout_and_execution.terminal_evidence: each attempt records terminal boundary kind, callback sequence/raw hash when a callback exists, entry/exit raw hashes, and signed terminal_position_lots; SEALED_STREAM_END never invents callback evidence
markout_and_execution.current_offline_implementation: complete generic offline PRIMARY/STRESS multi-signal replay over externally anchored sealed QUOTE/CONTROL custody, including generation-scoped admission, provider semantics, PIT accounting, terminal handling, exact reconciliation, and fail-closed coverage; real provider/schedule/PIT/holdout bindings remain unbound

offline_accounting_component.implementation_scope: standard-library deterministic offline component only; no network, credential, vn.py, RPC, order, or position authority
offline_accounting_component.scenario_constants: position scope is scenario_id x exact_contract; event order is collector callback order v1; all non-delay/non-adverse scenario fields are identical and frozen
offline_accounting_component.admission: same-callback exit transition is processed before a later callback-ordered admission; ineligible candidates do not occupy the slot; suppressed candidates retain blocker identity
offline_accounting_component.pit_binding: InstrumentTermsBinding, FeeScheduleBinding, and BrokerMarkupBinding require exact-one exact_contract + official_day + callback receive UTC matching plus authority/source/version/source_sha256 provenance
offline_accounting_component.fee: each leg is Decimal fixed_cny + price * multiplier * ratio_per_mille / 1000, exchange and broker components separately rounded to 0.01 with ROUND_HALF_UP; explicit zero is valid but missing is fail-closed
offline_accounting_component.current_close_policy: current candidate accounting permits one lane and one official trading day only, so exit is CLOSE_TODAY; CLOSE_YESTERDAY resolution is retained for a future separately authorized identity
offline_accounting_component.row_validation: deserialized execution quotes/legs and CLOSED/FAILED trade rows require exact types and are revalidated for raw hash shape, quote usability, frozen scenario, lane, contract, side, position, price, fee rounding, and PnL arithmetic; fixed-grid aggregation additionally requires externally trusted PIT terms/fee/markup bindings plus an independently supplied raw_record_hash-to-ExecutionQuote map derived from verified custody, exact-compares each submitted quote to that map, reconstructs every present leg, and exact-compares the leg before accepting provenance
offline_accounting_component.liquidation_mtm: PRIMARY and STRESS use the actual liquidation side; STRESS applies one adverse tick to the exit execution price before PIT fees
offline_accounting_component.daily_coverage: PRIMARY aggregation requires exactly one sealed and priced evidence row for each of two product x exact-contract x 20 official-day cells and reconciles every CLOSED or FAILED attempt count; only a reconciled zero permits a zero-trade day
offline_accounting_component.daily_aggregation: PRIMARY-only fixed 20 ascending official-day grid; select exactly three official days by pooled cross-product net descending then official-day ascending tie break, remove those same dates from each product, and still require every product to pass without pooled rescue; producer daily/best3 remain empty until an authorized complete real holdout passes every coverage gate

independent_raw_to_pnl_auditor.implementation_scope: standard-library-only offline module with no project-local producer/accounting imports and JSON-primitive inputs only
independent_raw_to_pnl_auditor.trusted_inputs: sealed partition manifest/raw byte envelopes plus external terminal partition hash, terminal seal id, and freeze SHA-256

data_gate_denominators.quote_record_denominator: all raw QUOTE rows, including invalid and explicit duplicates; CONTROL rows excluded
data_gate_denominators.qualified_observation: non-duplicate finite positive uncrossed unlocked two-sided BBO inside an eligible segment
data_gate_denominators.state_changing_observation: qualified non-duplicate BBO whose price or size differs from the previous qualified baseline in the same lane
data_gate_denominators.quality_gate_policy: legal BBO rate, distinct positive side sizes, mirrored-size rate, crossed-or-locked rate, state-changing count, and mid-change count are recomputed from raw quotes; crossed-or-locked numerator examines every parseable positive price pair before size validity or duplicate exclusion; quality_gate_passed is independent of lifecycle_gate_passed
data_gate_denominators.coverage_plan_authority_policy: every exact coverage row includes nonempty canonical authority/source/version/source_sha256; these are externally frozen provenance claims, not self-authentication
data_gate_denominators.explicit_cell_gates: data_gate_passed requires replay_complete, one generation and clock epoch, lifecycle, raw quality, eligible plan with days_to_ltd > 10, every quote inside the plan interval, at least one quote with >=60000000000ns remaining, exact contract/session Q95, provider semantics in PROVEN_NO_USABLE_ID or PROVEN_UNIQUE, exactly one full-interval PIT terms binding and one fee/markup binding per offset with no partially overlapping competitor, exact admission/attempt/trade reconciliation, and only CLOSED_NORMAL or FAILED_NO_ENTRY attempts
data_gate_denominators.replay_complete_policy: every raw quote and exact-segment lifecycle record for the frozen cell must have been processed before any global unpriced STOP; planned suffix cells after the cutoff fail
data_gate_denominators.lifecycle_policy: exactly one collector start/stop and one segment start/end; every cell quote must lie strictly inside the segment bounds; DISCONNECT, RECONNECT, CLOCK_EPOCH_CHANGE, or abort inside the segment fails while an event after segment end does not retroactively taint it
data_gate_denominators.reconciliation_policy: ADMITTED accepted_trade_id must biject exactly to terminal attempt_id, and CLOSED attempt_id must biject exactly to trade attempt_id, including a valid zero-attempt cell
